rulesTestNames: lets active managers get their event setup views and nothing else
owner: Host event setup view evaluator: hostReadModels event setup view triggers
read: current managers of an active organizer get their event's document; a view not written yet reads as missing; nobody lists the collection
write: server only; written by every evaluation that changes it and deleted with the event or its setupRevision
migrationNotes: Publication readiness checks every requirement as if the event started one millisecond from now; the phone applies the clock, so the view needs no sweep.
sourceCoverage invalidSource with its incompleteSource keeps the previous summary and means the step must not show it.
